The excerpts are head text only, with no visible diff hunks, so no specific security-control change can be attributed to them. The prose states fail-open MTP to target-only (invariant 7, line 1111), which is an availability posture rather than a confidentiality change. The Bonsai 9B defaults enable paged attention and encrypted SSD prefix caching (lines 639-641); this falls under T-041/SEC-035, and the doc says the kill switch and cache identity/security checks still apply. Source was not supplied to verify whether that default is new in this PR, so the next pass should check Bonsai9BModelPolicy and PrefixCachePolicy for changes to the DARKBLOOM_PREFIX_CACHE gate. docs/developer/test.md patch hunk @@ -174,6 +174,34 @@ adds an opt-in live test, ModelCheckpointRestoreContentionLiveTests.
